result:
I'm marking round 104 as **PASS**. That comes with one new Medium bug that B needs to plan, and one acceptance row I left out because B wrote it wrongly. All browser rows that can run in the cloud were run in real Chromium, in fresh incognito sessions with no login, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true.

**What the fix now does:** when the same status sentence is set twice in a row, the status area actually updates and a screen reader announces it again. Before, the second time produced no change on the page.
- **Space twice on an empty project** (1280x720 and 1440x900): the same sentence both times. The second press inserted a new line with that exact text, and the status element itself was never replaced. Nothing played, and the accessibility tree shows the sentence the same number of times (2) after each press.
- **Enter twice on a library row that failed to load** (I blocked `hero-music.mp3`): the row "CZABA hero — საჯარო preview" showed the exact failure sentence both times, it was re-inserted on the second Enter, and no clip was added.
- **Fade-in drag:** I did it 3 times, 81 mouse moves each. Each drag inserted 81 status lines, within the limit of moves + 2. The fade stopped at its limit (the full clip length, 101.352 s), it made exactly one Undo entry, and Ctrl+Z set the fade back to 0. There were no long main-thread stalls.
- **Status wording:** adding a clip, Fit (by clicking the button; there is no Fit shortcut in the code), Delete and Undo show exactly the sentences the previous published version produces. The status line stays one line high at 1280.
- **No network or console problems:** the page made no requests to `/api/studio-token`, R2, the recording APIs or `/api/download`, and sent no `Authorization` headers. There were no hydration warnings and no errors beyond the expected cart/backend noise.
- **Premium access is not bypassed:** with no login, the header link opens the Studio demo page with its badge, `/studio/middle-east` asks you to sign in and shows no workspace, and `/api/studio-token` returns 401. The fake-Bearer sub-check is BLOCKED (backend unavailable in cloud).
- **Tests and A's changes:**
  - My own search finds the same 69 test files as A, and all 1122 tests pass.
  - I reproduced A's four main sabotage checks with my own code changes. Each one turned the expected tests red.
  - I read A's "fails before the fix" log myself, and it matches the task.
  - The code changes stay inside the allowed lines, and protected files are unchanged at the start and at the end.

**New bug for B: A-R104-REPEAT-DRAG (Medium).** If you drag a clip into its neighbour and hold it there, the same "move blocked" sentence (`გადატანა დაბლოკილია…`) is now re-inserted and re-announced on every mouse move. In my test, 81 moves gave 81 insertions, 80 of them that sentence. Holding a fade at its limit does the same: 21 identical readouts. This stays within this round's limit, so it fails no acceptance row, but it is new since the last published version. I inferred that comparison from A's "before the fix" unit tests rather than running the old version in a browser. A suggested the fix: switch those calls in `ArrangementClip.tsx` (frozen this round) to the silent update form.

**SR-REGION-STABLE is not in `passed`.** It requires three different status sentences from adding a clip, then Space to play, then Space to pause. Play and pause never set a status, in this version or the previous one, so only two sentences can appear. Everything else in that row held: the status element was never replaced, always had one child, and the playback time advanced while playing. SR-TEXT-REG covers the same intent with four different sentences. B should rewrite the row, for example add → Fit → Delete.

**Not run:**
- The full test suite, typecheck, build, Biome, `npm run verify` and the smoke tests are left to the root gate.
- The real screen-reader check (Tech Lead item R104-T) was not done.

**Still to do:**
- The new implementation doc 092 still says the round is waiting for C.
- The regression round is due on or after 2026-10-24.
